name: MATILDA
aka: Mesa Associate's Tactical Integrated Light-Force Deployment Assembly
def: Remotely operated scouting and surveillance robot made by Mesa Robotics, sold in versions such as Urban Warrior, Block II and Scout.
facts: Options include a manipulator arm, weapon mount, sensor mount and fiber optic reel
The basic system includes the platform, control unit and battery charger
Name stands for Mesa Associates' Tactical Integrated Light-Force Deployment Assembly
